design.primary_comparison: SPLIT0/SPLIT50 vs C50, stepwise residual RMS matched
design.selection: One global setting selected on development joint success, then frozen for disjoint source images.

preregistration.primary: edit_ok AND subject_ok AND pattern_ok AND NOT artifact; failed generation remains in denominator
preregistration.annotation: Blind arm labels; two independent reviewers and adjudication; no API required.
preregistration.selection: Use global development joint-success rate, then edit-success rate; tie selects lower standalone NFE. Retain all arms in report.
preregistration.budget: SPLIT0 and SPLIT50 match C50 at each source node by RMS. Report gain clipping and achieved budget error.
preregistration.reporting: All tasks and seeds. Source-cluster paired intervals; dog rain/snow are one source cluster. NCC and feature similarity are auxiliary.
preregistration.result_status: Planned experiment; image quality has not been measured.
